## Follow-up change 2687: the I2/I3 section-label drift, fixed on main

Change **2683 merged** as `84ef284833be`; its Change-Id is consumed, so the residual advisory is
raised as a NEW change rather than a fourth patchset.

**Gerrit change 2687** — https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/2687
Branched from the merged tip `84ef284833be` (fetched from the `gerrit` remote directly — the
GitHub mirror was still at `4c9940348148` at the time, ordinary replication lag). Fresh Change-Id
`I5dde4834…`, same `rebar-ticket: a9d1-c7f3-cfd9-44ff` trailer, DCO signed.

**Diff: 2 lines, comments only.** `tests/unit/test_alarm_window_tuning.py` — the first section
divider now reads `I1 + I2: no unclearable alarms` (it covers both breaching-side tests) and the
second reads `I3: no unfireable alarms`. Divider widths preserved; no behaviour, no test logic and
no terraform touched. The module docstring, the runbook and the two dividers now all use the same
I1/I2/I3 numbering.

Why it was worth a second change rather than left alone: this is the file whose job is enforcing
that numbering, so a reader resolving an I2/I3 disagreement anywhere else would come here and be
misled by the nearest comment — the same 'a comment asserting what the thing beneath it no longer
says' defect the merged change exists to remove.

`(bugfix-size-attestation)` should not fire: 2 non-test lines against a 150-line floor. The
plan-review attestation earned for 2683 remains certified regardless.

Ticket stays `in_progress` until 2687 merges. Not submitted.
